pattern: filter two periods and groups, derive two percentages
question: compare two districts gaya nalanda for both years 2022 and 2023, both service rates
gold_sql: SELECT district, year, ROUND(100.0 * institutional_deliveries / pregnancies_registered, 1) AS delivery_percent, ROUND(100.0 * postnatal_check_48h / pregnancies_registered, 1) AS postnatal_percent FROM maternal_services WHERE district IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda') AND year IN (2022, 2023) ORDER BY district, year
sql_duckdb: SELECT (SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2022 THEN anc4_completed ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2022 THEN pregnancies_registered ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM anc_visits WHERE district = 'gaya') AS service_rate_2022, (SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN anc4_completed ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN pregnancies_registered ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM anc_visits WHERE district = 'gaya') AS service_rate_2023
